verdict.rationale: Kong provides a directory of OpenAPI specifications for its own APIs (kong-docs-9), supports importing/exporting OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 specs via Insomnia and Inso CLI (kong-docs-26, kong-docs-31), and its Dev Portal exposes machine-readable API documentation for browsing and trying operations (kong-docs-21). Declarative config via decK also supports machine-readable, versionable API definitions (kong-probe-4).
